name: Rectangle
description: This object corresponds to a rectangle control. The rectangle control displays a rectangle on a form or report.
remarks: You can move a rectangle and the controls in it as a single unit by dragging the mouse pointer diagonally across the entire rectangle to select all the controls. The entire selection can then be moved to a new position.

events.name: Click
events.description: The Click event occurs when the user presses and then releases a mouse button over an object.

events.name: DblClick
events.description: The DblClick event occurs when the user presses and releases the left mouse button twice over an object within the double-click time limit of the system.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: The setting determines if the DblClick event occurs. Setting the _Cancel_ argument to True (1) cancels the DblClick event.

events.name: MouseDown
events.signature: MouseDown(Button As Integer, Shift As Integer, X As Single, Y As Single)
events.description: The MouseDown event occurs when the user presses a mouse button.

parameters.name: Button
parameters.description:
The button that was pressed to trigger the event. If you need to test for the _Button_ argument, you can use one of the following intrinsic constants as bit masks:

  • acLeftButton The bit mask for the left mouse button.

  • acRightButton The bit mask for the right mouse button.

  • acMiddleButton The bit mask for the middle mouse button.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description:
The state of the Shift, Ctrl, and Alt keys when the button specified by the _Button_ argument was pressed or released. If you need to test for the _Shift_ argument, you can use one of the following intrinsic constants as bit masks:

  • acShiftMask The bit mask for the Shift key.

  • acCtrlMask The bit mask for the Ctrl key.

  • acAltMask The bit mask for the Alt key.

parameters.name: X
parameters.description: The _x_ coordinate for the current location of the mouse pointer, in twips.

parameters.name: Y
parameters.description: The _y_ coordinate for the current location of the mouse pointer, in twips.
